evidence.mission_note: As a utility_capability candidate, the GX460's tow package and true low-range 4WD offer real capability the household RX350 lacks, but the documented cluster of suspension work and an unresolved warning-light/temp-gauge event just weeks before the sale mean this only functions as a capability add-on to evaluate carefully, not as a substitute for the RX350 or a fix for the 335i's role.
evidence.rationale: The attached Carfax and Lexus dealer service history establish an unusually complete maintenance trail across all three owners, confirming a clean title, no structural damage, and recent replacement of front struts, rear brakes, and rear shocks. Against that strength, the same records show a Minor Damage event dated 07/24/2026 that the listing does not disclose, a front bumper replacement (7/16/2026) not framed as accident-related, an unresolved temperature-gauge fluctuation with flickering warning lights reported 8/7/2026 that the customer declined to have diagnosed, and a post-repair suspension noise complaint that a BAR inspection did not fully lay to rest. No documentation addresses secondary air injection, KDSS hydraulic health, or frame/underbody rust despite six years of Alaska registration under a prior owner. Mileage and title data are internally consistent across the listing, Carfax, and service records, and CA emissions passes are documented through 2025.
evidence.next_action: Request the front-bumper/damage-event invoice and a follow-up diagnostic on the temperature-gauge/warning-light event from the seller, then schedule an independent PPI at the transacting Lexus dealership focused on cooling, KDSS, and secondary air injection before making an offer.
